q: Plants make their own ____ molecules, using the process of photosynthesis. (2025- Set 1)
e: Plants synthesize organic compounds like carbohydrates during photosynthesis.

q: Most plants do not have ____ bodies like animals. (2025- Set 10)
e: Plants have branched, non-compact bodies to maximize surface area for light absorption.

q: Glucose can be moved through the ____ as part of the sucrose molecule. (2025- Set 6 / 2026- Set 2)
e: Sugars are converted into sucrose and translocated through the phloem tissue.

q: In a plant, the dissolved organic compounds are transported in the ____ tissue. (2025- Set 5)
e: Phloem tissue specializes in translocating organic solutes throughout the plant.

q: The uptake of water is a passive process and occurs by____. (2025- Set 4, 7, 9)
e: Water enters plant roots along a concentration gradient via osmosis without energy expenditure.

q: The dissolved organic compounds are transported in the ____ tissue. (2025- Set 12)
e: Photosynthetic products are distributed to plant tissues via phloem.

q: The dissolved mineral ions are transported in the ____ tissue. (2024-Set 2)
e: Xylem vessels conduct water and dissolved mineral ions upward from roots.

q: In passive absorption, water moves through the____ of the root. (2025- Set 11/2026- Set 1)
e: The apoplast pathway consists of continuous cell walls through which water moves passively.

q: In hot conditions, transpiration plays an important role in ____ the leaves. (2025- Set 2)
e: Evaporative loss of water vapor cools leaf surfaces and prevents heat damage.

q: Transpiration helps the shape and structure of plant parts by keeping cells ____. (2026- နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Water intake maintains cell turgidity, keeping plant organs structurally firm.

q: Translocation is the movement of dissolved ____through a plant. (2025- Set 5)
e: Translocation transports organic solutes such as sugars and amino acids.

q: The phloem tissue is a ____ tissue. (2025- Set 3)
e: Phloem is a complex tissue made of multiple cell types including sieve elements and companion cells.

q: In all the vertebrates, circulatory system is in the form of ____transport system. (2025- Set 10)
e: Mass transport systems rapidly move fluids carrying nutrients and gases over large distances.

q: In large multicellular organisms, the surface area to volume ratio is ____. (2025- Set 2)
e: Large bodies have a smaller surface-area-to-volume ratio, requiring specialized transport mechanisms.

q: The systemic circulation carries oxygenated blood from the ____to the cells of the body. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: The systemic circuit receives oxygenated blood from the heart and delivers it to body tissues.

q: The passage of blood through the vessels is called the ____. circulation (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: The movement of blood through the cardiovascular system is termed blood circulation.

q: The heart is made of a ____ muscle. (2025- Set 3)
e: Cardiac muscle is specialized involuntary striated muscle composing the heart walls.

q: Arteries carry blood away from the heart towards the ____ of the body. (2025- Set 7)
e: Arteries transport oxygenated blood from the heart to tissues and cells.

q: The umbilical vein carries oxygenated blood from the ____into the fetus. (2025- Set 8)
e: The umbilical vein conveys oxygenated, nutrient-rich blood from placenta to fetus.

q: The major arteries close to the heart must withstand ____ surges. (2024-Set 3)
e: Elastic fibers in major arterial walls allow them to stretch under high pressure surges from ventricular contractions.

q: Plasma is the____part of the blood. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အများစုတွင်မေး)
e: Plasma is the liquid extracellular matrix of blood containing water, proteins, and dissolved solutes.

q: Plasma, blood cells and ____flow from a cut vessel. (2026- Set 2)
e: Blood components including plasma, blood cells, and platelets flow out during vessel damage.
